requirements: Python >=3.12, torch (CUDA build; tested API only: nn, optim, cuda, float64 matmul) and numpy; nothing else; no network, no credentials, no repo checkout; image nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch:25.12-py3 (torch 2.10dev) is sufficient, python:3.12-slim + torch wheel is the alternative
preflight_command: tar -xzf rd_ddpm_packet.tar.gz && PREFLIGHT=1 bash rd_diffusion/job.sh   (hash and import check only; never trains; expect {"preflight": "ok" ...})
full_command: tar -xzf rd_ddpm_packet.tar.gz && OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 MKL_NUM_THREADS=2 OUT=out bash rd_diffusion/job.sh
gates: job.sh runs: preflight -> control (refuses to continue without CUDA; checks DCT, steady state, CPU determinism, CPU-vs-CUDA solver and network, schedule) -> run
resources: one H100 80GB, one GPU, CPU threads <=2 for the numpy parts, expected memory a few GB (peak sampling batch 16384 x 2 x 64 fields); no multi-GPU

runtime_budget.expected: roughly 15-25 min; this is an ESTIMATE scaled from CPU smoke timings, NOT measured on a GPU
runtime_budget.note: if the logged step rate predicts more than 30 min of training, stopping is acceptable and counts as a failed run, not a partial result

outputs.part2_model_eval.tgz: checkpoint.pt (~5.4 MB EMA weights + train-only normalisation), evaluation.json (all metrics, receipts, hashes, timings, GPU telemetry), examples.npz (direct solver vs generated fields, reverse trajectory), train_loss.jsonl
outputs.cap: each part well under 16 MB compressed (expected under 8 MB)

local_controls_actually_run.cpu_smoke_end_to_end: artifacts/rd-diffusion/cpu_control/smoke_evaluation_NOT_A_RESULT.json (150 steps, 30 dev settings only; untrained; numbers meaningless)
local_controls_actually_run.cuda_control: NOT run locally (no GPU on this host); it is the first gate inside the job
local_controls_actually_run.tests: tests/test_rd_diffusion.py 13 passed (solver equals numpy rd_frames to 1e-9)

no_duplicate_submission: this worker submits nothing; infra_director owns dispatch
